blocks.content: Start in Logs Drilldown to choose a service and investigate its logs without writing LogQL.
Open Logs Drilldown to begin with the services in your Loki data source.
blocks.tooltip: Start with the services available in your log data.

blocks.content: You have reached the starting point for investigating your service logs.
Choose a service, narrow its logs by text, and compare labels, extracted fields, and patterns before returning to the matching records.

Choose a service you want to investigate: open the picker, type an available service name, and select its matching option. Service names come from your own data, so make this selection yourself; confirm its log records are visible before continuing.
blocks.tooltip: Choose an existing service and look for its log records before continuing.

blocks.content: Read a visible log record and choose a meaningful term from it, then enter that term here and press Enter to apply the line filter. Choose the text yourself so the results match your own logs; check that matching records remain visible.
blocks.tooltip: Enter text from a visible record and press Enter to narrow the results.

blocks.content: Open **Labels** and inspect the labels associated with your selected service. Compare these with the details you saw in the log records, keeping your line filter in place.
blocks.tooltip: Inspect the labels associated with the service while keeping your text filter.

blocks.content: Open **Fields** to inspect details extracted from the log records. Compare one extracted field with what you just saw under **Labels** to distinguish record details from labels.
blocks.tooltip: Compare an extracted record detail with the labels you just inspected.

blocks.content: Open **Patterns** to inspect recurring log shapes. Look for a pattern that helps you recognize repeated messages in the service you are investigating.
blocks.tooltip: Look for a recurring message shape that helps you recognize repeated activity.

blocks.content: Return to **Logs** and check that your selected service and line filter are still applied. Read a matching record to confirm you have returned to the same narrowed investigation.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm the service and text filter remain applied and matching records are visible.

blocks.content: Your investigation is ready to continue when the selected service’s log records are visible, the line filter is still applied, and matching records remain after your visits to Labels, Fields, and Patterns.
